title: August and the Oath Revisited
author: Jonah Winterbourne
blurb: Lena Blackwood, the youngest member of a dying guild, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
